title: Rock Star Reunion: Guitar Hero Plays with His Old Band After 40 Years!
summary:
Have you ever not talked to a friend for a really long time, and then one day you just say hi again? That's kind of what happened with rock star Ritchie Blackmore and his old band, Deep Purple! Ritchie helped start the band way back in 1968, but he left in 1993 after some big arguments. For years, the other members said they would never play with him again. But guess what? On August 12, at a concert in New York, Ritchie walked on stage and played 'Smoke on the Water' with them—and the crowd went wild!

Ritchie said it all started when he woke up one morning and thought, 'It would be nice for the fans if I just played one song with them.' So his wife, Candice, called the singer, Ian Gillan. Ian said the idea 'made me smile,' and the whole band said yes! Ritchie was a little nervous because he hadn't played his electric guitar properly in 30 years. He usually plays acoustic guitar now, with long fingernails for picking. For the electric guitar, he had to use a pick and cut his nails short. He even lost his place in the song for a second, but he didn't care. He said he was there to see old friends, not to play perfect notes.

Ritchie is 81 years old and had a heart attack last year, so he couldn't play guitar for months. That makes this reunion even more special. He said, 'We're all getting older. I think we realized it could be the last time we see each other.' The band's singer, Ian Gillan, posted after the show, 'What a pleasure it was to welcome Ritchie Blackmore on stage with us.' It sounds like everyone was happy, and maybe some old wounds are healed. Will they go on tour together? Probably not, but for one night, the music brought them back together.
why_it_matters: It shows that old arguments can soften over time, and that sharing music can help friends reconnect even after many years apart.
